scope: Synthetic conditional-accuracy OC source and timing only; not full experiment driver; no candidate data or inventory OC executed

input_vector_contract.source: Eligible inventory output oc_vectors, null on any selection/projection/resource failure; no arbitrary replacement vectors
input_vector_contract.shape: Exactly {segment_lengths:[3 integers1500..2000],counts:[3][2][L_r nonnegative integers],directory_cases:[3][2][list of {position:int,directory_hash:lowercase64hex}]}; L_r=min(2000,post-C0 envelope_r), shared across ages/arms within repository; repository and age order unchanged; cases stable position then original cluster/key order; positions0..L_r-1; counts exactly agree; at most2600 per age; null/empty/wrong-length counts refused
input_vector_contract.projection: After association exclusion, retain all-added90% Cold/80% C0, renamed without modified75% Cold/50% C0, any modified/mixed-other0%; int(SHA256(UTF8(x11a-project-v4 NUL repository NUL age NUL commit NUL clusterID))) *100 < percentage*2^256
input_vector_contract.label_cap: Among retained proxy cases, lowest2600 SHA256(UTF8(x11a-label-v5 NUL repository NUL age NUL commit NUL clusterID)), full case key ties, arm omitted; count by original commit position
input_vector_contract.output_fields: segment_projection_inputs.projected_selected_counts are unlabelled yield; projected_label_selected_counts are capped OC counts; resource_proxy_selected_including_exposed never thinned
input_vector_contract.freeze: Mandatory protocol reviewed_inventory adopts original inventory authority+output seal. Wrapper --inventory must be sole sealed output; verify original inventory authority with original sealed export manifest. Exact non-null vectors equality; hash vector bytes, inventory output, original authority/seal, protocol authority in build record. --recipe must be recipe_sources-pinned. OC/sensitivity fixed399; timing overrides forbidden.
input_vector_contract.directory_hash: SHA256(UTF8(x11a-directory-v6 NUL canonical_repository NUL normalised product cluster.directory)); same across ages; report largest directory share, retained_directory_case_count N, retained_directory_count K and effective_directory_count N^2/sum(n_d^2) per repository x age after capped retention; N=0 gives K=0,effective=0

role_matching: lowercase paths before role patterns; parent owns role implementation

truth_margins.infeasible_companion: For precision defects only, if f>1 replace recall with min(.90,precision*(1-q)/(q*(1-precision))); report resulting own pooled margins. Never clamp heterogeneous boundary.
truth_margins.none_assignment: always incorrect (a1 vs existing truth a0)
truth_margins.limitation: Existing failures abstain only. Precision-only .75/.78 defects at low none share may require reduced recall: infeasible under this abstain-only generator, not inherently infeasible in data. Wrong-ID-on-existing errors are not simulated; .72/.88 infeasibility is likewise generator-specific.

latent_distribution.revision: two-point ICC rather than beta, fixed before inventory; direct measured compute decision
latent_distribution.formula: P=(1-sqrt(rho_merge)-sqrt(rho_dir))*mu+sqrt(rho_merge)*I[U_merge<mu]+sqrt(rho_dir)*I[U_dir<mu]; reject negative mean coefficient; independent merge/directory and correctness/none families
latent_distribution.variance: (rho_merge+rho_dir)*mu*(1-mu) for shared merge+directory; distinct-merge same-directory ICC rho_dir; same-merge distinct-directory ICC rho_merge. Copula age/arm correlation is Gaussian, not Bernoulli Pearson.
latent_distribution.family_independence: existing-correctness and none-assignment latent families independent; gold independent of both and trials
latent_distribution.normal_draw_order: Z, Z_arm[0:2], Z_age[0:2], then Z_age_arm in age-major arm-minor order; all iid standard normal, including zero-weight factors
latent_distribution.copula: U=Phi(normal_factor); a=agecorr,c=crossarm; gold uses same factor c=1 and threshold q; c/a describe latent Gaussian correlation, not achieved binary Pearson correlation
latent_distribution.ordering: repository streams independent; within repository: position0..L_r-1, merge correct latent family, merge none-assignment latent family; case ordinal0..max(age capacities)-1; gold copula, assignment-trial copula; age Cold then C0, raw A/B labels, missingness race; skip absent age cases only after drawing gold/trial copula
latent_distribution.directory_order: Sorted union of directory hashes across ages, independently keyed directory/repo stream: correctness copula then none-assignment copula for every key (including rho_dir=0). Draw once per directory and reuse at every position and age.

streams.seed: big-endian uint64 of SHA256(UTF8(x11a-oc-v6 + NUL + decimal scenario + NUL + decimal replicate + NUL + stream))[:8]
streams.replicates: zero-based, seed never reused across scenario/replicate/repository/family
streams.vectorisation: Independent scenario/replicate/repository stream work may execute in any scheduler order; do not change draw order inside one stream. Bootstrap streams isolated from generator; same block positions across ages/arms/metrics.

missingness.unit: one shared label mask per repository/age/position/case across adoption arms, not separate races per arm
missingness.correct_weight: 4 if either adoption arm has a correct assignment, otherwise1
missingness.error_sensitivity_weight: 4 if either arm has a wrong assignment or an existing abstention, otherwise1
missingness.limit: At each proposed removal recompute both arms recall U_all/(E_known+U_all) and assigned unknown/(A_known+A_unknown), stop at first proposal exceeding m in either arm, do not skip.
missingness.count_preservation: Never remove outputs, sampled cases or unknown counts from denominators. m0 has one mechanism only.
missingness.labels: Truth shared across arms. A/B independently flip covered probability.01; true existing correct a0 probability.99 else a1 for A/a2 for B. True-none erroneous existing likewise distinct IDs. One shared gold kind Bernoulli(.5) per case; independent kind flips.01. Disagreement or disjoint IDs adjudicated to truth; agreed mistakes retained. Quality per age recomputed on nonmissing raw answers: covered kappa>=.60 and actual routing<=.40.

estimators.pool: half Cold estimate plus half C0 estimate, not ratio of pooled counts
estimators.verdict: Ordered negative if any adequately measured best upper<.80, otherwise inadequacy=>inconclusive, otherwise all six worst point/lower>=.80=>supported; age accuracy bounds not vetoes
estimators.support_gates: Each age known A/E>=800, sampled cases>=1200, active merge positions>=100, both unknown fractions<=.05, quality passed, nonzero bootstrap denominators in>=95%; projected vectors capped2600/age. Binding synthetic pr_cap=0.
estimators.negative_gates: Both ages own-metric known count>=200, valid quality/missingness/interval. Other cell inadequacy does not prevent valid negative.

bootstrap.real_analysis_seed: big-endian uint64 first8 SHA256 bytes of UTF8(x11a-analysis-v6 NUL canonical repository NUL bootstrap); PCG(seed,seed XOR0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)
bootstrap.real_analysis_draw_order: Independent repository streams: commit bootstrap and directory-bootstrap, names x11a-analysis-v6 NUL canonical_repository NUL bootstrap or directory-bootstrap; each10000 replicates; ceil(L_r/20) circular starts IntN(L_r) or K IntN(K) draws per replicate, same draws across ages/arms/metrics.
bootstrap.method: circular moving block20, ceil(L_r/20) uniform starts in0..L_r-1, final block truncated to remaining positions for total exactly L_r; same starts ages/arms/metrics; precompute L_r rolling20-commit sums then vectorise integer additions, sum individual positions for partial final block
bootstrap.percentile: sort finite pooled estimator draws, index floor(p*(n-1)), p=.025/.975; more5% zero denominator invalid
bootstrap.interpretation: 399 approximates real10000; OC controls simulated event probabilities for399, not bootstrap coverage or approximation error. Historical 12-study 10000 comparison is smoke-only, not calibration or validation of rev6 directory estimator.
bootstrap.directory_method: Sorted union of directory hashes, K keys; resample K keys with replacement, paired across both ages/arms/all metrics; sum all cases for each key, absent age contributes zero; independent directory-bootstrap/repo stream. No area-specific reseeding. 399 OC,10000 real.
bootstrap.combination: For each pooled metric lower=min(commit lower,directory lower); best-case upper=max(commit upper,directory upper). Each component separately requires>=95% finite draws; empty/invalid component invalidates bound. Same estimator in OC and real; counts399 vs10000 only difference. Robust to either dimension singly, NOT exact multiway-cluster coverage guarantee; threats: two-way dependence, directory rho>.10, few-directory bootstrap.
bootstrap.directory_optimization: Exact coalescing identical [age][arm]Counts vectors in first sorted-directory occurrence order. For every replicate still draw K IntN(K) on same directory stream; tally selected class multiplicities then scale/add each class. Integer sums and seeded sampled estimators identical to individual-key aggregation, no changed bootstrap distribution.

false_support: union over supported arms with any own true pooled repository metric strictly below.80, not support of a healthy other arm
boundary: separate union over supported arms with own true pooled metric exactly.80; homogeneous and heterogeneous boundary both arms counted in union, not classified strictly defective

sequential_MC.interval: Gate one-sided CP lower BetaInv(.05/3,k,n-k+1), upper BetaInv(1-.05/3,k+1,n-k); zero/one endpoints; implementation interval(alpha=2*.05/3). Descriptive bounds use two-sided simultaneous alpha. Inverse beta48 iterations, CF tolerance2e-14 max300 fails closed.
sequential_MC.family: Intersection-union feasible iff every relevant event in every binding scenario passes; one-sided level .05/3 at each of3 looks gives false-feasible<=.05, no scenario/event multiplicity penalty. Bonferroni two-sided simultaneous intervals alpha=.05/(56160*3*6) descriptive ONLY, never gate.
sequential_MC.uniform90_pass: both arms support lower>=.80 and false-not-supported upper<=.05
sequential_MC.defect_boundary_pass: own-defective union upper<=.05 and own-boundary union upper<=.05
sequential_MC.fail: Any relevant confidence interval wholly beyond required limit; otherwise continue; unresolved after1024=>not-testable, never silently pass
sequential_MC.record: every visited look event counts and intervals, every scenario final status including failures. Continue other scenarios unless total compute stop.

sensitivity.indices_0_14: Base catalogue0..14 unchanged, each crossed rho_dir0/.10; actual indices0..29
sensitivity.indices_15_98: Base catalogue15..98 unchanged, each crossed rho_dir0/.10; actual indices30..197; old variants same order
sensitivity.temporal: hold merge latent probabilities for20/40 commits starting circular origin0; trial/gold draws remain independent across positions except specified age copula
sensitivity.decision: descriptive only; no support-power promise and no candidate replacement; sensitivity mode separately reports full fixed-sample counts and bounds

projection.formula: sample seconds /120 *scenario_count *replicates; measured synthetic timing only, not runtime guarantee or universal worst-case bound
projection.capacity_risk: Every measured minimum fits384h; singleton maximum does not at either length pattern. Shorter mixed lengths need not time faster due to synthetic data distribution and measurement noise. No monotonic performance or universal feasibility claim.
projection.decision: Retain384h fixed serial cap under R-064; no universal feasibility claim. New synthetic v7 metadata supplies measured timing for per-repository lengths1500/1666/2000 across balanced/concentrated/singleton directory profiles. Actual OC measures elapsed/studies and projects minimum256 replicates over all56160 binding scenarios; projected minimum beyond384h or elapsed cap => pre-map not-testable, no directory filtering, scenario removal, or reselection. stop_reasons preserves first OC gate failure and separate compute stop; status is first stop reason. Sensitivity may stop at8h with remainder unmeasured. No prior headroom claim carried forward.

timing.rationale: Keep fixed384h cap; new directory robustness honestly makes directory-heavy OC possibly not-testable. No claim all inventories fit, no historical3x margin carried forward; all binding scenarios retained. Timing profiles descriptive compute evidence, not statistical evidence.
timing.closure_contract: tool-pins-v7/oc-build-recipe-v7.json; same pinned -pgo=off compiler/environment, current exact selected package/file closure, reviewed stdlib bootstrap_v6.py before helper import. Original authority/seal/vector/recipe bindings mandatory. Historical v6 recipe/timing metadata preserved; parent freezes final digests.
